book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: Rau To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Korin Muuŋ 1 Korin—1 Corinthians

content: Paulus isavsaav inimale yes ŋgara to taan maau

Yam toŋvetaz, matamim iŋgal. Sawa to nalat ve navotia Maaron aliŋa payam, you nasavia saveeŋ pughu ariaŋa inimale yes ŋgara to taan to tighamgham pa taudi izadi ne maau. You nasavia saveeŋ rauraua payam, leso aghazooŋ pa Maaron ŋgar toni. Ŋgar tonowen, muuŋ iyooŋ, ve aazne ivot ighazooŋ wa. 1Kor 1:17
Pasa, sawa to nalat ve naneep toman gham, ŋgar tiou iyaryaaŋ naghaze nasavia Yesu Krisi varu moghon, ve mateeŋ toni izala ai pambarooŋ. 1Kor 1:23; Ga 6:14; Pil 3:8
Sawa to naneep toman gham, matughezaaŋ tiina igham ghou le tinig irur. Ve nayamaan taug naghaze tapirig imbool. Mbaŋ 18:9; 2Kor 11:30, 12:5,9

Ve sawa to navotia varu poia payam, you nasavsaav nanimale yes ŋgara to taan pa nagham lolomim ne maau. Eemoghon Maaron Avuvu igham uraat toman tapiri ila lolomim. Tauto ipatooŋ ghou ighaze saveeŋ to nasavia payam, nene saveeŋ onoon.
Nataghon ataam tovene, leso ŋgar to tamtoghon inim pughu pa ghurla tiam sob. Naghaze Maaron tau tapiri inim pughu pani, ghoro poia. 2Kor 4:20; 1Tes 1:5
Maaron Avuvu ipaghazoŋan ghiit pa Maaron ŋgar toni

Eemoghon yes to ŋgar todi imatu pa Maaron ve saveeŋ toni, yei nisavsaav padi pa ŋgar tiina to Maaron to muuŋ iyooŋ ve aazne ivot ighazooŋ. Muuŋ kat, sawa to sambam ve taan tivot sone, ye igharaat ataam pataghaaŋ wa, leso igham ghiit tala taneep tomani ila ŋguruba lolo. Ŋgar toni tonowen, ite kat pa ŋgar to yes ŋgara to taan tisasavia pa sawa tonene. Ve yes to tighamgham pooz pa sawa tonene
tikankaan pani paam. Yes pooza tonowen, muri Maaron pale itatan di tinim mbeb sorok. Ro 16:25+; Ep 3:5,9; Kol 1:26; Yems 3:17

Todi eta ighazooŋ pa Maaron ŋgar toni maau. Ve inimale tighazooŋ pani, tone irau tirab Tiina toit Yesu to iza tiina pa tapiri ve poia toni ne izala ai pambarooŋ maau. Lu 23:34; Yo 16:3; Mbaŋ 13:27; 2Kor 3:14
Ŋgar yoŋgaaŋ to Maaron to nisasavia ne, timbood saveeŋa pataghaaŋ tighaze:

content.text: “Maaron igharaat mbeb popoiadi naol pa yes to lolodi ineep toni. Mbeb tonowen, ite kat. Tamtoghon eta ighita di pa mata, ma ilooŋ varudi pa taliŋa sone. Ve tamtoghon eta irau igham ŋgar padi paam maau.” Is 64:4; Yer 3:16

content: Eemoghon iit, ghoro Maaron ipaghazoŋan ghiit pa ŋgar toni yoŋgaaŋ tonenen ila uraat to Avuvu Patabuaŋ wa. Maaron Avuvu ighita mbeb tisob. Ŋgar yoŋgaaŋ kat to ineep ila Maaron lolo ne paam, Avuvu ighita. Mt 13:11; Yo 16:13
Laak, sei iwatag katin tamtoghon ite lolo? Maau. Ye tau moghon to iwatagi. Maaron tovene paam. Tau Avuvu moghon to iwatag katin lolo. Ite paam maau.
Avuvu to iit taghami, ye itaghon ŋgar to taan maau. Ye ivot ila to Maaron tau. Maaron igham Avuvu pait, leso tawatag mbeb popoia to ye irei di pait itaghon tau lolo ve poia toni.

Tovenen yei nisavsaav pa mbeb tonene. Ve ŋgar to nisasavia, yei nighami ila to yes ŋgara to taan maau. Maaron tau Avuvu to ipaghazoŋan ghei pani, ve ighamgham pooz pa saveeŋ isob to nisasavia. Tovenen saveeŋ onoon to Maaron Avuvu isavia payei, tauto nipaghazoŋan pughu pa yes to titaghon ŋgar to Maaron Avuvu. 1Kor 1:17, 2:4

Ighaze ŋgeu eta itaghon ŋgar to tamtoghon moghon, ye pale izurun ŋgar to inim pa Maaron Avuvu, ve ighita ŋgar tonowen inimale ŋgar to borouŋa. Irau ighazooŋ pani maau. Pasa, Maaron Avuvu iuul ghiit, ghoro taŋgabiiz poian ŋgar tonenen, ve taghazooŋ pani. Yo 6:44, 14:17; Ro 8:5+; 1Kor 1:18,23
Tamtoghon to ighaze itaghon ŋgar to Maaron Avuvu, nene irau iŋgabiiz poian mbeb tisob ve ighilaal di: Sa to poia, ve sa to samia. Tamtoghon tovene, yes to titaghon ŋgar to taan, irau tiŋgabiiza maau.

Pale tiŋgabiiza vena? Maau. Pasa, saveeŋ ineep pataghaaŋ wa. Ighaze: “Sei iwatag katin ŋgar to Maaron, ve irau ipatooti pa ŋgar pida? Maau.” Ro 11:34 Eemoghon iit, ghoro ŋgar to Krisi ineep toit. Ro 12:2; Ep 4:23

footnotes.text: -7 Yes pooza to Paulus isavia di, nene yes daba samsamiadi to taan, ma Ŋgeu Samia toman avuvu samsamiadi.

Mbeb popoia to Paulus isavia di, nene mbeb to tagham di ila mateeŋ to Krisi izala ai pambarooŋ. Nene mbeb tovene: Krisi ireu sosor toit, ve igham ghiit taneep deŋiaad ila Maaron mata, ve irei Avuvu Patabuaŋ pait.
Saveeŋ waaro tonene avaat iŋarua tamtoghon pida to Korin to tiveleg Paulus pa uraat toni, ve tiyouyou avodi pani. Ughita 2Kor 10:10.
